reviews.text: Almost 2 hours in and I'm having a lot of fun. Well except for the fact that my village is quickly dying from starvation. So I'll go find a new group of people to lead out into the wilderness and try again. They'll probably all die as well. But I'm having a lot of fun trying to build a sustainable village. Bring on the next batch of settlers (victims)!

[quote] 《Settlements rising》是由[url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/44750642]The Catalyst Crew Games[/url]制作并发行的一款中世纪经营建造类游戏。玩家需要在游戏中从开局一辆马车到后面人丁兴旺且城市繁华的殖民城市。和模拟游戏一样，刁民无处不在，玩家需要照顾村民们的各种需求，与此同时还要抵御袭击和自然灾害等等。贸易系统也是比较完善的，记住那句老话：要想富先修路。游戏目前在EA，不过内容还是比较完善的多种难度亦或者自定义资源和难度，并且中文翻译非常完全，并且每个村民都有自己的中文名字，而不是像某些模拟游戏，村民名字都是英文随机。另外最有意思的本作还有土地价值，离市中心很近的土地价值一般都很高，这就很真实了，连游戏里的房价都是如此！ https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3342106828 在本作中村民有各自的属性特特长，村民可以是原住民或者是外乡人，根据村民的特长他们会被系统分配到各个岗位上（当建造了特定的建筑物），村民能够从事的职业非常多，比如前期的猎人、矿工，到后面中后期教师、酿酒师等等。周遭环境除了市中心一圈以外，其他黑色区域需要玩家选择村民去探索，探索资源的过程中小心掠夺者或者野生动物。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3342106834 本作也有天气系统，天气会影响村民的舒适度，冬天需要外套、木材取暖，还会影响动植物的生长和出没，冬天会影响浆果收成而春天则会增加。并且在特定的间隔时间内，玩家还可以进行一次抽卡，卡片辅助村庄成长效率，比如有可以提高生产项效率卡牌，还有可以直接获取特定资源的卡牌等，玩家根据自己当前所需选择卡牌即可。 https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3342106846 本作属于慢性模拟经营游戏，后面玩家还可以建造探险船派遣他们去做任务探险，后面还有敌袭时间，这时你就需要考虑加固你村庄防御系统等。而且玩家在游戏中还可以观察每个村民的细节，不得不说本作的NPC各个建造、采摘细节做得很不错，不过可惜的是本作的建模贴图有点太简约了。如果你是一个喜欢中世纪建造模拟游戏的玩家，本作还是非常推荐的！ [quote] 游玩百态，将游玩心得用汉语化作玩家的指明灯，(๑•̀ㅂ•́)و✧ [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35402408/]点击这里关注汉化语录~[/url] 如果喜欢这个评测，请点个赞让更多人看见 [/quote] [/quote]

I can't recommend the game in its current state, it feels more like a demo. It's not a bad game technical wise but it has issues. The trees and stone don't give enough resources so you find yourself leveling entire forests constantly just to build basic buildings. Almost every single building has an orange roof so the entire village looks the same. The game itself is very easy as there isn't many buildings or production chains, I understand it's early access but times have progressed since banished which is the closest I can compare this to. The only difference is this has cards and raiders. Id say wait until the game has more features.

[h1]Another Banished-like city builder; it's just OK right now...[/h1] Cons: [b]#1.[/b] The game has a resource degradation system, which cannot be turned off [b]#2.[/b] The game has an item durability system, which cannot be turned off [b]#3.[/b] No tutorial [b]#4.[/b] Multiple missing tooltips in multiple places [b]#5.[/b] No map [b]#6.[/b] The game's logic when it comes to moving stuff from/to storage or buildings is broken (I explain exactly why in my video) [b]#7.[/b] The enhancement card system in the game feels tacked-on and unnecessary, so it should be improved or just removed [b]#8.[/b] The game is for sale in countries that commit crimes against humanity, like Izrael and Ruzzia. In summation: This is a borderline recommendation, simply due to #1, #2 and #6. If the devs can fix those, then the game will be easily recommendable. Here's my first impressions review: https://youtu.be/50RG82m1iOc For more reviews, visit my curator page: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/7851637/ For my full recommended list of games: https://steamcommunity.com/id/lfpg/recommended/

Alot of mechanics from Farthest Frontier are here. Down to building names and descriptions, they are in this game. One of the improvements I'd say are in this game vs. FF or Manor Lords is the depth and control over the villagers. There are enough setting differences to set this game apart from others in terms of replay value but nothing ground breaking found yet. Maybe with a little more time in. I'd recommend as a fun take on RTS city building.

A casual little town builder that doesn't bring anything new to the genre or present much challenge, but executes well on the well trodden path of those who came before it. If you are looking for comfortable familiarity with a fresh coat of paint, this is your game. Comparable to Banished or Kingdoms and Castles.

就是说，为什么敌人入侵后敌人不作高亮处理，一旦进村，有兵也没用，根本找不着在哪，抢劫也没有什么明显破坏，就更看不着了，这是为了追求什么真实性吗？那我感觉还是出个按钮吧，可以开关敌人显示，让人枪完了都不知道在哪抢的。还有游戏里又把金子从普通仓库转移到国库里的方法吗，我没找到。还有内城门，有没有可能做个友方判定，就是居民可以自由进出，但强盗啊，熊什么的不行，要不然每次还得手动开关，怪麻烦的，但不是说要取消手动，有时候也是要用的，但就是智能点不会更舒服吗？除了这些游戏其他的都挺好，画风我也挺喜欢，玩法也挺好。就是能不能改改这些小毛病，有时侯这些小毛病真是让人玩不爽。对了，还有农场能不能也加个按钮，可以选择自动宰杀多余宠物，到后期农场多了真顾不上。

THIS. This is the game I've been searching for. I a pretty serious Cities Skylines player- It is my most played game on Steam by several hundred hours. The issue with CS is you have to focus on the big picture of a large city. This game allows more finite and immersive city building experience, by making it feel personal. The smaller scale also allows for a more interactive as well. You really can make the little village yours. I'm sure in the latter game it gets larger, but its still much more interactive than CS. If you also love Tiny Glade as much as I do but wished for more interaction, a little challenge and NPC's this is what you've been searching for. While not as detailed in terms of building and decor, it shines in the management aspect, in a way that is refreshing compared to CS. Very engaging game as well. I lost 4 hours in a snap. I can see this being a good game to quell panic attacks..

Cute art style, you can see the villagers going about their business and routine, which is always a good point. Nice and simple to understand UI. It all feels intuitive IF you are used to these type of games, there’s no tutorial, no backstory guiding you, so if you’re new to these games, you’ll be very lost. Also, it feels like its more of the same, nothing new, no innovations, if you ever played Banished, Foundation, Settlement Survival or any other games within this niche, you’ve played this one. The lack of a backstory makes it dull really fast. In the current state i wouldn't recommend buying it unless there’s a sale or something. If there’s a backstory update or something really innovative come up I’ll come back and change my review.
Pretty ok but to much micro managment.

游戏整体上还是不错的，但深度极为不足。以下是可以改进的方向： 1.目前来看，游戏完全没有科技系统，纯粹就是几种建筑各生产一个资源。 2.没有科技，因此教育和市民培养显得无用，仿佛为了建造而建造。 3.生产和服务建筑也没有升级内容。 4.军队战损比不合理，没有更加高级的装备，只能用人去填。 5.外贸既无脑又繁琐，直接买买买就好，根本不用自己生产。 总言之，主要就是没有科技和文化的相关升级和拓展，导致了建筑、人口只需要考虑有没有，不需要（也无法）考虑质量，而外贸则帮我更简化了这些思考，导致后期就是点点点。卡片也是噱头类，对游戏的进程影响并不大（大多都是数值调整，缺乏特殊事件类）。

I don't know why but this game is just like a more cute version of Farthest Frontier. All the building types and the way it get resources from the wild is just the same of Farthest Frontier. Basing on which, It adds a system of the villagers' skill, which is somehow the only different thing I got from this game. I see this game is still ongoing and I hope the dev team will create more novel content of their own. The game is good though, so i give a good comment after all.

人物动画做的最好的城建游戏，好多细节动作，比如去仓库拿起东西，放下推车铲屎，放下篮子采蘑菇等小动画，让我觉得这些小人比较有生命力，虽然如此，进入建筑的动画却比较敷衍，走到门口直接消失了，同类许多游戏已可以做到走到门前打开门进去再消失的效果。倒也不太影响，这款游戏的人物动画仍然是我见过的最细节的城建游戏。但是游戏现在并不有趣，对于村庄发展并没有什么深度，基本开局的几个小人就可解锁大部分建筑，都盖了一遍后就没什么发展的需求了，内容非常非常少，冲着不错的动画和干净的画风给个好评，但是玩法非常肤浅。最后，如果后续有更新的话，希望可以给地面上加点草，当把树和石头砍完了，那个突兀的纯色地面让人无法直视。

This is one of those times when I wish there were more options than yes or no, but since those are my only ones, I'm going with no. I play a lot of city/civ builders, and this one is meh. It doesn't seem to offer anything unique to the genre, and is missing enough QOL features that it's really not worth it. It's not worth the money, or the time I've put into it. I keep playing in the hopes that it will become fun, but it hasn't happened yet. I get warnings that I don't have enough food, but the fishery stopped producing because the inventory is full. Now, apply that to every clothing item, including leather items, and tools, and you have the past few hours of my playtime. I have construction that haven't been built for hours. (113 pop with 4 builders and 9 labor). They're waiting on wood. (517 wood in stock). it feels as if I keep doing something wrong, but for the life of me, I can't figure out what. I will revisit this sometime before I die, I hope, and if it improves, I will change my review, but for now, find a better city builder--there are a lot of them out there.

Man is this frustrating. Meanwhile raiders come every 2 years or so to steal all kinds of resources and there is no way to build defences fast enough to keep them out. If this one(?) bug could have been fixed this game could have a chance.

玩法上好似是加强画面的"放逐之城"， 深度上还远不如打上MOD的"放逐之城"。 1个2025年的游戏， 比不过十几年前的单人游戏，我也是醉了。 同时也是我玩过的殖民模拟和城市建造游戏中内容最少的， 没有之一。 种植蔬菜只有4种，养殖牲畜也只有4种， 有抽卡，只能抽中物资和buff， 没有科技和特殊建筑， 有盗贼，但很呆， 有商人，出船队后可以无限买物资，但是仓库很小，买又没地方放。 理论上可以无限多的人建立大都市， 实际上过200人后，很多人根本无活可干，就纯白吃白喝。 过少的建筑种类和需求， 导致玩家不清楚建议大都市意义何在。 打折时买的，只出了一半的钱。 体感上觉得游戏也只有一半。 一反一复， 不相当于全款买全款玩么、 坏了，洒家中计了...

I’ve put a good chunk of time into Settlements Rising, and it’s one of those city builders that really sneaks up on you. You start with a small wooden settlement and a handful of villagers, and before you know it you’re managing layered production chains, expanding neighborhoods, and fine-tuning your economy to keep everyone happy. What I love most is how natural the growth feels — you’re not just placing buildings, you’re shaping a living town that gradually becomes more complex and efficient. There’s always a small problem to solve or an upgrade to work toward, and it hits that perfect “just one more year” loop. It feels thoughtful without being overwhelming, and when your settlement is running smoothly because of the systems you set up, it’s incredibly satisfying.

This game deserves way more attention. Since the dev of Banished finished that project long ago, Settlements Rising (and maybe Settlement Survival) are the closest experiences I’ve had that really capture that same vibe. Sure, it’s not perfect yet, but the frequent updates give me confidence it’ll keep improving. The UI is a bit unattractive at first, but you get used to it quickly, especially since the graphics and animations are really solid. I can already see myself sinking many more hours into this one. Good job devs! Keep it up :)

Man I want to like this game so bad but either the developers are new or just blind to QOL details. Clicking on a settler and moving them does nothing for giving actions. You can pointlessly move settlers around but can't have them pick up any items or tell them to perform any actions. The time passes so quickly while your settlers move so slow that it's silly. Each second or so of real time is a day in the game so you're blasting through time like an acid trip which with seasons in play can put you in a bind pretty quick. The roads that you can construct do absolutely nothing for speeding up your settlers. There are a few great aspects of the game that I love such as being able to re-direct areas for your buildings to hunt, gather, fish so it's not a small static circle around your building requiring optimal placement. The enhancement cards for added bonuses that can either be saved or used later in other games. Overall the issues present in this game make it seem like this game left early access too early... If I could get a refund I would consider it however that ship sailed as the only way to truly leave a decent review is to spend the necessary time to truly gauge the games qualities. I only truly pursue full refund on games that are absolute trash and this isn't one of those but man it needs some work...

Set up correctly it can be relaxing, and plain out adorable. It's good to kick back, and watch the villagers do what they do. I like how you can customize the tasks, while also leaving it base tasks. AI seems smart enough to self manage, and that is a slam dunk in my opinion.

Peacefully enjoyable city builder. If you like the idea of an ever expanding village while managing food production on top then the game is worth a try. Not nearly as harsh as other city builders or survival colony sims like Frostpunk or Oxygen Not Included, but I would say the relaxing charm to the city building has definitley hooked me. I hope they keep updating the game, expanding on what they already have and improving the villagers. (Improving the ai pathing, adding more depth to the bandit raids, maybe the abiltity to deform the terrain with villagers given enough in game time and increase their speed when walking on pathways) Otherwise a very nice game.

Abandonware? It's a decently implemented no-frills settlement builder, with just the basics, and that's about it. Nothing groundbreaking. Last tiny patches were released Sept 2025. The previous minor content beta was in March of 2025 and released to production a bit more than a month later, in April 2025. Since then, a possibly interesting pending content update has been seemingly stuck in perpetual beta since February 2026, but without a peep about it since then. Is this ever going to roll out into a production release? Hello? Is anyone there? Crickets.

Good game for sure. I wish there was a little bit more depth in trade, like having multiple trading docks instead of limiting it to 1. Overall I have enjoyed it a lot, the card system is cool and useful.

It's very good - this is basically Banished 2, and a full spiritual successor to Banished. However this offers a more 'living' feeling to your settlement, and a deeper supply system. In addition to defenses and combat. Graphically it is very nice, the music is fantastic and relaxing. The procedural seed map system is excellent. There is no tutorial or story here, you get right in and get to work. The environment, predators and vagabonds are your pressure points for your settlement and off you go. Beyond that don't expect anything else - it's Banished 2, pure and simple and it does a fantastic job at being Banished 2. Rank Game Feels Like Banished 1 Banished Pure survival village sim Banished 2 Settlements Rising Modernized Banished Banished 3 Farthest Frontier Expanded/evolved Banished Alternate timeline Manor Lords Cinematic Banished Multiplayer branch Kingdoms Reborn System-heavy Banished Settlements Rising captures the feeling of Banished best.
